text.2:259: Or (bethink thee of) the like of him who, passing by a township which had fallen into utter ruin, exclaimed: How shall Allah give this township life after its death? And Allah made him die a hundred years, then brought him back to life. He said: How long hast thou tarried? (The man) said: I have tarried a day or part of a day. (He) said: Nay, but thou hast tarried for a hundred years. Just look at thy food and drink which have not rotted! Look at thine ass! And, that We may make thee a token unto mankind, look at the bones, how We adjust them and then cover them with flesh! And when (the matter) became clear unto him, he said: I know now that Allah is Able to do all things.
text.17:49: And they say: When we are bones and fragments, shall we forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?
text.17:98: That is their reward because they disbelieved Our revelations and said: When we are bones and fragments shall we, forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?
text.23:14: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
text.23:35: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?
text.23:82: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
text.36:78: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
text.37:16: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
text.37:53: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
text.56:47: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
text.75:3: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
text.79:11: Even after we are crumbled bones?
